page.title: Starlite 2046 in Marbella: Book a Pre-Concert Yacht Charter Cruise

faq.q: What time should we start our pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: Most guests depart Puerto Banús around 6pm for a 2-hour sunset cruise. That gives you time to enjoy the coast, have a drink, and reach the Starlite auditorium by 8.30pm. If you want a longer sail, a 4pm departure works well.

faq.q: Which boats are available for a Starlite 2046 pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: We have Tier A boats like the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) from €749/2h. For a larger group, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719/4h and includes a jet ski. Other yachts are available on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras – just show up and enjoy.

faq.q: How far is the Starlite auditorium from Puerto Banús?
faq.a: The Starlite 2046 auditorium is about 10 minutes by taxi from Puerto Banús. It’s located near the Nagüeles quarry, just off the Golden Mile. Your skipper can help you arrange a taxi when you dock.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food or decorations?
faq.a: Yes, you’re welcome to bring your own food or birthday decorations. Just let us know in advance so we can prepare the boat. The included snacks are light – think crisps, nuts, olives – so bring a picnic if you’d like more.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on the day?
faq.a: We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we’ll offer a full refund or reschedule. Our boats have bimini tops for shade, but in heavy rain or high wind we won’t sail.

faq.q: Can we extend the cruise after the concert?
faq.a: Absolutely. Many guests book a 2-hour pre-concert cruise and add a late-night return. We can arrange a later docking time – just mention it when you book. The boat will wait for you at Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How do I book a Starlite 2046 pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: Book directly via our WhatsApp number. Tell us your preferred date, group size, and boat type. We’ll confirm availability and send a payment link. For Tier A boats, the price is fixed; for others, we’ll quote based on your needs.

data.body_html:
Starlite 2046 is Marbella’s biggest summer music festival, drawing international acts to an open-air auditorium carved into the Nagüeles quarry. A pre-concert yacht charter turns the evening into a full coastal experience: you depart Puerto Banús at sunset, cruise past the Golden Mile with a glass of cava, and arrive at the concert relaxed and ready. This guide covers timings, boats, pricing, and everything you need to book a Starlite 2046 pre-concert cruise in Marbella.

Why take a pre-concert cruise?

Starlite’s shows typically start at 9pm, but the real atmosphere builds from 7pm with the red-carpet arrivals and cocktail bars. A yacht charter lets you skip the traffic and enjoy the Mediterranean light show instead. You’ll board at Puerto Banús, cruise along Marbella’s coast for 2–4 hours, then dock and take a 10-minute taxi to the auditorium. It’s a seamless transition from sea to stage.

Best boats for a Starlite 2046 pre-concert cruise

We recommend the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 for groups of 8–11 people. Both are 12.5m flybridge cruisers with a sundeck, saloon, and plenty of seating. Price: €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours – all inclusive. For a larger party (up to 12 guests), the Mangusta 80 (24m) is available from €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a jet ski. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

Suggested itinerary for concert night

6pm – Board at Puerto Banús. Your skipper greets you with a welcome drink (cava or beer).
6.15pm – Depart the marina, heading east past the Golden Mile. Views of La Concha mountain and Marbella’s skyline.
6.45pm – Anchor near Cabopino beach or Cala del Faro for a swim stop (weather permitting). Snacks and drinks served.
7.30pm – Cruise back toward Puerto Banús. Sunset around 8pm in summer.
8pm – Dock at Puerto Banús. Taxi to Starlite auditorium (10 min, ~€15).
9pm – Concert begins.

What’s included on every charter

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full itinerary
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT)

No hidden costs. If you want to bring your own food or decorations, just let us know when booking.

How to book your pre-concert cruise

Booking is simple: send a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, group size, and boat type. We’ll confirm availability and send a secure payment link. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), the price is fixed. For the Mangusta 80 or other yachts, we’ll provide a custom quote. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance during Starlite season (July–August).

Why choose Boat Rental Marbella?

We operate our own fleet from Puerto Banús – no third-party aggregators. Every boat is maintained to Spanish maritime standards, and our skippers know the coast intimately. You’re not renting a boat; you’re buying a seamless evening that starts on the water and ends at one of Europe’s best concert venues.
